accepted.title: Waiting in the Library

Feeling sleepy means needing a nap.

hint.text: Think about how someone acts when they do not mind waiting for their turn.

accepted.title: Sister's Paper Castle

hint.text: Did you check whether the question asks for the same meaning, or the opposite?

accepted.title: Ayaan's Campaign Poster
accepted.text: At her cousin Ayaan's house, Ayaan excitedly unrolls a poster he spent all evening making for his school club election. The slogan is clever, but the lettering is cramped and hard to decipher. Meenakshi wants to help him, so she chooses to give a tactful response rather than blurting out her initial reaction. What does "tactful" mean here?

options.text: Carefully phrasing her thoughts so she is helpful without causing hurt
options.consequence: Ayaan listens closely and asks how they can space out the heading together.

options.text: Praising the poster as flawless so Ayaan stays cheerful
options.consequence: That would be flattering or insincere rather than tactful.

options.text: Pointing out every flaw bluntly so the truth is immediately clear
options.consequence: That would be harsh and direct, which can easily sting.

options.text: Quickly changing the topic to avoid sharing any opinion at all
options.consequence: That avoids the conversation entirely instead of being considerate.

hint.text: Meenakshi wants to help Ayaan fix the letters, but also cares about his feelings.

puzzle.explanation: Being tactful means being thoughtful and sensitive in how you speak, sharing necessary feedback without needlessly embarrassing someone.

options.consequence: The chat quietens down as teammates pause to reconsider their words.

options.text: Unconcerned about whether the team won or lost
options.consequence: Thomas cares deeply about the team, which is why he stepped in to help.

options.text: Agreeing with whichever teammate shouts the loudest
options.consequence: Thomas did not take sides just to keep the loudest voices happy.

options.text: Speaking bluntly without filtering any thoughts
options.consequence: Thomas paused and edited his message instead of reacting immediately.

hint.text: Notice how Thomas chose his words to avoid worsening people's anger.
